messages:
Sam H.: Morning — orbit async standup. Quick thread: what I did / blockers / today. Keeping it short, drop pings if you need help.
Anya R.: Did: landed canary tweak for routing weights, ran staging load test (no 429s). Blocker: need final token-bucket size decision for burst handling — current PR needs a number (pinging infra). Today: I'll open PR for the new rate policy and add the perf notes. @Sam H. can you eyeball the doc?
Koh: Did: reviewed the routing-policy CRD changes, started integration tests. Blocker: flaky e2e test in CI (timeout on auth handshake) — repro to follow. Today: triaging flaky test and pairing with Marco on auth handshake. Also pinging @Anya R. for a quick CR on the schema tweak.
Marco: Did: investigated yesterday's auth header rotation spike, found token refresh race; pushed a staging hotfix. Deploy log: `deploy-bot: deploy/gateway v2.7.1 -> staging (ok)`. Blocker: need to confirm whether to keep burst_limit=100 or drop to 60 for customers with aggressive clients. Today: will add a dashboard panel for per-tenant burst usage and create a fallout playbook entry.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: `infra/ci` triggered rollout `gw-service:v2.7.1` -> staging. Health checks OK. Logs: ````
Pods: 6/6 ready
no restarts
````
Lina: Did: triaged CS ticket #7782 (customer hitting 429s during batch job). Blocker: awaiting decision on temporary bump for that tenant. Today: opened support ticket + put suggested mitigation in the runbook. Also left comments on PR #4821 (rate-policy docs) — @Anya R. @Koh please take a look when you get a sec.
Sam H.: OK — plan for today: 1) I'm merging the minor schema change after @Koh confirms the flaky test is noise, 2) finalize token-bucket numbers with infra (I'll sync after this thread), 3) review @Lina's suggested mitigation and assign owner for the customer temp bump.
Anya R.: FYI I'll include the perf numbers in the PR description and link the staging trace. If anyone wants the traces DM me.
Koh: I'll push a test fix shortly, should be able to unblock the schema merge.
Marco: If we decide to lower burst_limit I'll draft the customer communication blurb. :thumbsup:
Sam H.: Thanks all — if no objections I'll merge schema by 13:00 and file the follow-ups. Ping here for handoffs.
Lina: assigning follow-up to @Marco for dashboards, @Sam H. for config decision, and @Anya R. for PR updates.
Sam H.: noted. End of thread.
